title: FutureBit’s Apollo III Bitcoin Miner Hits Micro Center Shelves in Its First Brick-and-Mortar Launch
summary: Bitcoin Magazine FutureBit’s Apollo III Bitcoin Miner Hits Micro Center Shelves in Its First Brick-and-Mortar Launch The Brooklyn company's compact home miner, rated at up to 18 TH/s and starting at $1,099.99, goes on sale Friday at four Micro Center stores, including the chain's new Austin location. This post FutureBit’s Apollo III Bitcoin Miner Hits Micro Center Shelves in Its First Brick-and-Mortar Launch first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
